summary.text: Mary Littleton is a Republican state representative from Dickson representing Tennessee House District 78 (Cheatham and part of Dickson Counties), a member of the 108th through 114th General Assemblies. She chairs the Children and Family Affairs Subcommittee.

paragraphs.text: Littleton was born on September 7, 1957, has four children and five grandchildren, and is a member of the Church of Christ.
In the House she also serves on the Judiciary and State & Local Government committees.

Her page lists membership in the North Cheatham Civitan, the Cheatham County Kiwanis and the Dickson High Noon Rotary, service on Tennessee's Safe Baby Court Advisory Committee and the Human Trafficking Advisory Council, and a listing as "TN GOP Vice Chair."
